component.name: Civics Audio Prep
component.summary: Hands-free audio study for the US naturalization civics test

description.p: Civics Audio Prep is a hands-free study tool for the US naturalization civics test (128 questions, 2025 version). The app speaks each question, pauses for you to answer aloud, then speaks the answer — highlighting the spoken word karaoke-style so you can glance at the screen anytime.

ul.li: Listen mode: start a session, put the window aside, answer out loud
Practice test that stops the moment you pass (12 correct) or fail (9 missed) — like the real interview
Flashcards and a browsable question list with known-question tracking
Headset and media-key controls via MPRIS
No ads, no data collection, no network access

description.p: Spoken audio uses your system's speech-dispatcher voices; install voice data for your study language for best coverage.
First desktop release: Windows and Linux.
